data.gender_notes: Koosha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'koo' meaning joy, happiness and 'sha' meaning self, this name signifies a joyful, content self. In Arabic, the name translates to 'the one who is happy and joyful'. The name Koosha carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Arabic. Parents who choose Koosha usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Koosha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
